entries.title: 竹林边，抓天牛
entries.finalEditPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: revised full-scene story postcard for the original Sichuan countryside game “旅行癞疙宝”.
Revise the supplied previous candidate into the user's newly specified story. The first image is the previous candidate / edit reference: preserve its recurring toad identity, indigo flower satchel, setting family, lighting family, color palette, and hand-painted visual language, but replace the former action and rearrange supporting scenery only as needed to make the new action coherent. Any second image is a supporting style reference for ordinary people and countryside only, not another scene to composite or an additional toad to copy.
OUTPUT: ONE finished opaque full-bleed image, 1536×1024 horizontal 3:2, no captions, lettering, panels, border, signature, logos or watermark.
STYLE LOCK: warm gentle storybook gouache / watercolor, economical deep-brown contours, olive / moss green, warm cream belly and sunlight, honey bamboo, natural gray stone, indigo accents. Keep the same stout broad low toad, fused head/body without a neck, half-lidded amber eyes, orange bean-shaped parotoid glands, short rounded limbs, cream belly and a few larger olive recognition spots. Keep one indigo cloth satchel, white flower flap, small brass clasp and red chili knot. No clothes or footwear on the toad, no new human ears or changed creature design.
LOW-SPECKLE REQUIREMENT: large coherent painted color shapes and mild modeling. Leaves one base green plus at most one broad shadow plane. Group grass, bamboo foliage and distant trees into clear clumps. Earth / stone surfaces have intact continuous base colors and only a few broad soft tonal shifts, retaining necessary joints and contact shadows. No dense soil dots, camouflage-like flecks, excessive tiny highlights or gritty paper overlay. Preserve character's key spots, not all-over tiny peppering. Not blurry, bleached, washed-out, flat vector or glossy 3D. Environment remains larger than the characters, with calm breathing room, not a close-up portrait.
Keep this an unhurried, warmly observed local-life story with restrained humor. Correct readable limbs and object contact. Only the story-implied new characters / props below.

NEW STORY: Replace playing with the bamboo dragonfly toy with catching a real longhorn beetle (天牛) at the edge of the bamboo grove. Keep the quiet Daoming bamboo-country courtyard, bamboo shade, plain gray-tiled farmhouse and distant fields in the reference's style. The toad crouches beside a low rough tree trunk among the bamboo; the beetle has just been caught from that trunk. Clearly show one small black longhorn BEETLE gently enclosed between the rounded digits of one raised forepaw at chest height; its whole hard elongated oval wingcase is visible, with a restrained few pale cream spots, SIX slender legs and TWO unmistakably long curved segmented black-and-cream antennae, longer than its body. The antennae have clear space, are not confused with extra legs, and the beetle is proportionately tiny compared to the toad's head, not a monster. Catch is gentle and loose, no crushing, injury, gore, torn wings or pinching antennae. The other forepaw supports the toad naturally on the ground. Toad looks closely at its catch with mild curiosity and a slightly tilted head, relaxed closed mouth: no licking, extended tongue or eating. Satchel rests nearby on dry ground.
REMOVE the toy bamboo rotor and spindle completely; no dragonfly toy, live dragonfly, butterfly, net, specimen jar, extra insects or human figures. Tree bark uses a few broad longitudinal shapes rather than noisy dots. Keep the little caught beetle readable against the cream chest / open air, not hidden by the hand. Natural peaceful afternoon light and clean ground shapes.

entries.title: 看人采耳，自己也眯了眼
entries.finalEditPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing Sichuan countryside hand-painted travel postcard, texture-balance revision.
Input: Image 1 is the ONLY image and ONLY edit target, the latest v6 simplified illustration. Preserve its exact composition and all story elements.
Primary request: the last cleanup made the painting a little TOO pristine and too smoothly polished/animation-like. Increase the amount of VISIBLE HAND-PAINTED MATERIAL TEXTURE by approximately 30% RELATIVE TO THIS CURRENT v6 IMAGE. Aim for a moderate, perceptible single-step increase (about 1.3 times the current texture), not a full restoration of the earlier busy version. Do not make a radical style change.
What to add: selectively repaint a modest extra layer of tactile gouache/dry-brush marks in the foreground wood and the broad ground planes. Use a few varied, softly broken pigment strokes, irregular worn patches and slightly rough paint edges, with light/dark differences in the existing local colors. Keep marks sparse, deliberately grouped and medium/coarse rather than pixel-sized; plenty of uninterrupted base color remains between them. This should look genuinely painted and slightly rustic, not like smooth cel-shaded anime scenery and not like artificial noise.
Tree: keep the current brown base, broad curved light plane and darker underside. Add a restrained scattering of short irregular bark breaks alongside the long directional grooves, a few worn tan/umber brush patches following the curvature. Stop well before dense tiled bark scales, all-over gray chips or camouflage.
Ground: add lightly broken dry-brush tonal variations to currently very smooth areas, keeping the correct material, intact base planes and existing contact shadows. Added marks should enrich the surface without dominating it. Preserve the current LARGE CONNECTED TREE-SHADE shapes and direction of sunlight. Only gently roughen some shadow edges; do NOT recreate the carpet of tiny disconnected leaf silhouettes or glittering sun flecks that was removed.
Leaves/background: a little subtle hand-brushed color variation inside selected larger foliage planes is fine, but preserve all silhouettes and leave most leaves simple. Do not add a new all-over paper/canvas/noise overlay, sharpen edges, change saturation, or alter depth of field. It remains the same warm Chinese countryside gouache/watercolor illustration.
STRICT identity/layout locks: one toad and one satchel stay exactly where they are on the foreground branch, same scale, pose, amber eye, orange glands, olive body, cream belly edge, short limbs and main wart spots. Keep the blue bag's white flower, brass clasp and red chili knot. Do not increase the toad's wart density or draw texture across its eyes, face or bag emblem. Preserve every human, their expressions, actions, clothing and every prop's location, scale and geometry. No new characters, no moved furniture, no changed camera angle/crop, no labels/borders/watermark. Output a full opaque native1536x1024 3:2 landscape illustration.
Specific scene: keep both human men at center-right doing ear cleaning, the reclining bamboo chair, gaiwan, towel and dark tool roll; the toad is watching from the tree. Preserve the gray stone paving grid and coherent moss seams. Add the modest extra dry-brush variation inside slab faces and restrained bark breaks on the large foreground branch; keep the ear-cleaning hand/tool gesture clear. Preserve the teahouse, umbrellas and empty bamboo tables. No text.

entries.title: 送片叶子顺水走
entries.finalEditPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story, targeted texture cleanup edit. Edit the supplied river postcard itself; keep its exact 1536×1024 landscape 3:2 composition, subject positions, perspective, warm clear afternoon lighting, palette, buildings, willow, river, boat, bridges, and all story content. The toad's face, anatomy, pose, olive body / cream belly, amber eyes, few key larger identifying warts, blue flower bag / brass clasp / red chili tassel, reaching forepaw, and single ochre fallen leaf with its ripple rings must remain intact and clearly recognizable. Do not add, remove, move or crop any story object. No text or frames.

Make ONE focused change: reduce excessive broken color flecks / speckled surface texture on STONE, WATER and distant FOLIAGE, restoring the game's clean large hand-painted color-shape baseline.
1. Most important: the vertical faces and horizontal tops of the large gray stone steps in left foreground must look like smooth, continuous painted gray stone planes, not battered camouflage. Keep each step silhouette and its necessary joints. Give each large stone face a single connected base gray and at most two broad subtle tonal areas, NOT many small random patches. Consolidate moss into a few coherent green edge patches near the water and joints, never an all-over fleck pattern. Keep broad sunlight and shade.
2. Water: retain blue-green color, the houses and willow reflections, perspective and the leaf's few clear concentric ripple arcs. Combine the numerous small sharp pale / dark dashes into far fewer longer, quieter, softly connected horizontal painted bands. Preserve luminous rippling water and legibility of reflected architecture but leave wider smooth color regions; no glitter, stippling or new splash details.
3. Distant leafy crowns: merge dense tiny highlights into connected mid-green / light-green clumps; keep characteristic willow hanging forms. Foreground leaves remain clean readable leaf shapes with a main color and one broad shadow.

Keep soft, slightly painterly modeled volume, deep-brown character contours, rich warm/cool color balance and crisp structural readability. This is NOT a blur filter, denoise smearing, whitening, flattening into vectors, desaturation, or change of art style. Do not invent paper grain, splashes, outlines on reflections or new textures. The finished artwork should feel quieter because material shapes were repainted as larger coherent shapes, not because focus or contrast was lowered. Export one complete opaque scene, same dimensions.
